categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the research and development, production, and sales of power electronic equipment. It specializes in power electronic conversion technology, providing solutions for photovoltaic power generation, electrochemical energy storage grid connection, and power quality management. Main products include photovoltaic inverters (PV Inverter), energy storage bidirectional converters (PCS), active power filters (APF), and low-voltage reactive power compensators (SVG), along with integrated system solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced power electronic conversion technology as its core. Key technologies include SiC and GaN semiconductor materials, high-efficiency magnetic components, advanced DSP control algorithms, multi-level topology innovations, and MPPT technology improvements. The company has achieved inverter conversion efficiency exceeding 99%. Manufacturing methods include modular parallel design concepts and integrated system solutions for both photovoltaic and energy storage applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include central enterprises, provincial state-owned enterprises, large private enterprises, and international photovoltaic and energy storage system developers and contractors. Key customer groups are large-scale ground-mounted photovoltaic stations, distributed photovoltaic systems, industrial and commercial rooftop installations, household photovoltaic systems, and energy storage projects. The company serves customers across generation-side, grid-side, and user-side energy storage applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with major presence in China (headquarters in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province) and extensive international operations. International markets include India, Saudi Arabia, UAE, United States, Brazil, Spain, Germany, Greece, South Africa, Algeria, South Korea, and Philippines. The company has established subsidiaries and offices in Hong Kong, Singapore, India, Spain, UAE, Germany, Greece, Brazil, USA, and South Africa, demonstrating comprehensive global market coverage.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the renewable energy supply chain. It manufactures and sells power conversion equipment (inverters and converters) that are essential components in photovoltaic and energy storage systems. The company also provides system integration services, positioning itself as both an equipment manufacturer and solution provider for renewable energy installations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) strengthening energy storage business as an industry leader with focus on large-scale storage and overseas markets; (2) accelerating global market expansion and supply chain localization; (3) maintaining leadership in domestic photovoltaic markets while expanding distributed business; (4) enhancing R&D innovation capabilities and talent development; (5) improving operational management through AI integration and digital transformation. R&D focuses on high-power inverters, 1500V systems, energy storage converters, and grid-forming energy storage solutions.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of photovoltaic inverters, energy storage converters, and power quality management equipment. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of products, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance for large projects, or upon receipt for distributed systems. The company also generates revenue from system integration services and technical support. Domestic sales are recognized upon customer verification; export sales are recognized upon completion of export customs clearance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: According to S&P Global's 2023 global photovoltaic inverter shipment rankings, the company ranks fourth globally. In the domestic energy storage market, the company ranks in the top two for PCS shipment volume for four consecutive years (2021-2024) according to CNESA statistics. Main competitors in photovoltaic inverters include Sungrow, Huawei, and Zhongzhou Inverter. The company maintains competitive advantages through technological innovation, large customer base, and successful project experience.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of 4.773 billion yuan, with net profit attributable to shareholders of 418.78 million yuan (46.49% increase year-over-year). Total assets reached 8.1 billion yuan (16.71% increase), and shareholders' equity reached 2.162 billion yuan (23.12% increase). The company demonstrates strong growth trajectory with improving profitability, evidenced by ROE of 21.45% and positive operating cash flow of 121.56 million yuan in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) comprehensive product portfolio covering 3kW to 8.8MW power range across multiple application scenarios; (2) industry-leading conversion efficiency exceeding 99%; (3) advanced integrated solutions combining photovoltaic and energy storage systems; (4) grid-forming energy storage solutions for enhanced grid stability; (5) extensive successful project experience in harsh environments (high altitude, extreme cold, high salt spray); (6) strong R&D capabilities with 490 research personnel; (7) established relationships with major central enterprises and international customers; (8) proven reliability and performance in diverse global markets.
